greeting: Zeke. Ten candles. Not bad, for you.
I got here first, obviously, and no, you don't get my candle for free. You have to earn it.
phaseIntro: Me first. Youngest goes first, that's the rule I just made.
Cake fight. Dodge my stuff, hit me with yours. Don't sell.
phaseWin: Okay. Okay! You got me. That was low key kind of sigma.
Take the candle. Mami's next and she is NOT playing.
phaseLose: L. Massive L. You want to try that again or should I just keep the candle?
afterFight: The cake's on the table. Or we run it back and I get my revenge?

greeting: Mijo. Come here. I have been standing next to this cake since four o'clock.
Ten candles already. And you walked the whole town for them, with the dogs, in those shoes.
phaseIntro: My turn, mijo. And no, we are not fighting. Nobody throws anything in my living room.
I say a word in Spanish, you tell me what it means in English, and then you walk over here and you hug your mother. Seven times.
phaseWin: Seven. Ay, mi amor, my heart.
Take the candle. Papi is next, and he is pretending he has no idea what is about to happen.
phaseLose: Otra vez, mijo. The words are not going anywhere and neither am I.
afterFight: Everybody is here and the cake is on the table. Do you want to go around again, or should we light it?

bossRef.taunt: No shooting in my house, mijo. Just answer me.

greeting: And I had nothing to do with any of this, by the way. The whole town, all ten houses, your friends waiting in them. No idea who would do that.
phaseIntro: Soup! Salad! With me. Let's see what the birthday boy has got.
phaseWin: That is thirteen candles, bud. Thirteen down, one to go.
Come here. Your mother and I have something to tell you.
phaseLose: Nope. Again. Going easy on you on your birthday would be insulting, and you know it.
afterFight: The cake is on the table whenever you want it. Or one more round, if you want to beat me properly?

bossRef.taunt: Fourteen years of practice, bud. Mine, not yours.
